interpretation: Job envelopes and step intervals are alternative views, never additive.
Execution interval wall time is not CPU time; unrecorded external waits and internal request/parse/verification costs remain unknown.
Separate workflow windows do not establish dispatch-to-custody, merge-to-custody or developer interruption endpoints.
Role labels and large intervals identify measurement regions, not redundant assurance, root cause or achievable savings.
Existing failed/cancelled/rejected baseline observations remain retained; these successful maintenance windows are not a matched statistical population.
